Only after functional_sim passes, run the remaining board-layer gate DAG and assemble board semantic evidence, including numeric comparison, protocol/order/count checks, DDR roundtrip, lifecycle evidence, and executed complete validation-scope weight consumption.

Reusing the invalid prior repair report or contaminated Stage7/Stage8 artifacts as validated inputs could repeat the fingerprint-integrity failure and falsely discharge active retry requests.

The current no-output symptom prevents data-order and numeric conclusions. Tolerance, expected outputs, checkpoint, stimulus, or golden artifacts must not be changed to obtain a pass.

Running dependent board gates, Vivado synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI release, or board runtime before functional_sim and the remaining board-layer gates pass would violate hierarchy ordering and contamination barriers.

The smallest legal repair is an adapter-local, simulation-only observability and checker-binding correction followed by a fresh exact-wrapper functional_sim rerun with all immutable semantic artifacts preserved. Do not replay certified lower layers or run backend tools.
